reason: I build client sites for a living and I could wire an LLM API to a site's content over a weekend, so paying monthly for something I can build and own feels wrong. I might try the free plan on one client site, but I wouldn't pay in month one.
objection: I can build this myself with an LLM API, and I'd rather own the stack than depend on a vendor. If I resell it, I'm tying my clients to someone else's product and its pricing.
would_change_my_mind: A white-label Agency plan that I could resell to clients at a markup, with proof of a measured lift on a real site, so it's clearly less work than building and maintaining my own.
